thread:
samir: hey team :wave: quick onboarding snag — my benefits page shows me as "employee only" but I enrolled my spouse during onboarding and uploaded the dependent documents. also my commuter card reimbursement isn't showing up in expenses (receipt submitted). lastly bank verification is still pending (last4 1111) and i'm worried about direct deposit + first paycheck. who should I poke to get all these synced?

zoe (people-ops): hi samir, welcome! sorry for the hassle. can you confirm where you uploaded the dependent docs (benefits portal or email)? and the commuter receipt filename? i'll loop in payroll/benefits. for direct deposit: did you see the micro-deposits in your account?

samir: uploaded to benefits portal (file: samir_spouse_docs.pdf) and cc'd benefits@redwood.com. commuter receipt uploaded to expenses as samir_commuter_march.pdf. no micro-deposits yet.

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-04-01 16:00 UTC — payroll file exported. Cutoff for changes to this cycle was 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC. Submissions after cutoff apply to next run.

maria (payroll): hey samir  thanks for the details. if bank verification is pending we usually do micro-deposits within 48 hrs after you add the account. if they don't appear before cutoff the default is PayCard for first pay. if you want direct deposit now, upload a voided check to https://payroll.redwood.com/upload or DM me a screenshot with account/routing (blur other details). on the spouse coverage: payroll won't start spousal deductions until benefits sends the dependent feed. ben — can you confirm receipt of samir_spouse_docs.pdf?

ben (benefits): checking the portal now. i see the upload but the broker requires dependent docs to be manually validated for spouse coverage. i've flagged it as high priority. ticket #BEN-4601 opened. ETA 48 hrs. if validated and broker releases the feed we can backdate deductions to the requested effective date; payroll will need to process a retro adjustment if deductions already ran.

samir: thanks. one more thing — on the commuter reimbursement, the expense status shows "awaiting approval" but my manager already approved in DM. is there a manual step finance needs?

zoe (people-ops): sometimes manager approval in Expensify vs Slack DM gets out of sync. can you add the approval note in the expense app or ask your manager to re-approve in Expensify? if you want faster, tag finance@redwood.com on the expense thread.

maria (payroll): also flag: if spouse coverage is added after cutoff and the broker backdates, payroll can adjust employee deductions and/or employer contributions retroactively. regarding tax withholding: I noticed your W-4 shows single in payroll. If you changed it during onboarding but it's not reflected, please resubmit the W-4 change form here: https://payroll.redwood.com/forms/w4-change and reply once done. We'll queue correction for the next run.

samir: submitted W-4 change (form id W4-215111). manager re-approved expense in Expensify. uploaded voided_check_samir.png to payroll upload.

people-ops-bot: ticket BEN-4601 updated: broker acknowledged receipt, validating dependent docs. ETA 2026-04-03 09:30 UTC.

ben (benefits): thanks samir. i've requested an immediate feed to payroll once validation completes. if broker can backdate to 04/01 we'll request payroll retro-adjustment. if not, we'll ask HR to manually protect holiday/eligibility as needed.

maria (payroll): received the voided check, thanks. i'll prioritize direct deposit verification and confirm with banking partner. if micro-deposits still pending at 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC we'll default to PayCard for the cycle but can process a manual transfer once verified. i'll update this thread after the bank confirms.

zoe (people-ops): follow-up for samir: if anything still shows pending after 2026-04-03 ping here and we'll open an off-cycle request for payroll/benefits. welcome aboard and sorry about the admin runaround :hugging_face:

samir: super helpful, thanks everyone :pray: I'll check back if I don't see changes by Friday.
